description.describe_ch: In terms of theory and application: collection and presentation of data; measures of central values and spread; probability as a measure of uncertainty; sampling and sampling distribution of the sample mean; confidence intervals; hypothesis testing; regression and correlation.
description.describe_eh: In terms of theory and application: collection and presentation of data; measures of central values and spread; probability as a measure of uncertainty; sampling and sampling distribution of the sample mean; confidence intervals; hypothesis testing; regression and correlation.

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: Assignments, homework and small quiz. Attendance is 10 % of practical test ( 5% + 25%).

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
In special situations, the grading proportions of item 1, item 2 and item 3 can be slightly modified.
The grading is based on  attendance and absence, classroom interaction and participation in discussions, assignment submission and lateness, assessment and make-up exams, cheating and plagiarism, or bonus points.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Students should avoid all forms of misconducts such refusal to submit the homework, using the mobile to chat or speak with someone during
class.
 Whenever students need to delay submitting assignments or cannot attend class, they should notify the teacher via email (in English or Chinese).
Students need to be active and avoid disturbing the class hours. When students fail to abide by the policies, they might suffer consequences. For
example, students who do not attend to the classes nor do the homework on time for no reason will get 0 point. Plagarism is also 0 point. Both
L1 and L2 languages are allowed for emails, discussion and assignments.
學生需要積極參與並避免干擾上課時間。當學生未能遵守規定時，可能會受到後果。例如，無故缺席課堂或未按時完成作業的
學生將獲得0分。抄襲行為同樣將被處以0分。電子郵件、討論和作業可以使用L1和L2兩種語言。上課期間拍照和進食通常不是
良好的行為。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1. Remember: We are in Accounting Department not in linguistic Department. Hence, Students should not be afraid to speak English in this EMI
Class.
2. Remember: The instructor and you make one team. Fell free to see him or the TA whenever you are in need of help.
Bief, the instructor and the students are one team. We need to work together. We shoul avoid as much as we can any unneccessary conflicts.
老師和學生是一個團隊。我們需要共同合作。我們應盡量避免任何不必要的衝突。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Integrity of Course Materials:I request that you preserve the integrity of the course materials. Under no circumstance should you make public (web postings, social media,etc.)  class notes, handouts and other materials thatilearn of this course by the instructor. Academic Honesty:All students taking (auditing) this course have, in essence, agreed to the FCU's Code of Academic Honesty.About my academic work, students should not lie, cheat, steal the words nor ideas of others. Brief, Students taking this course should show high level of integrety and honestty in all aspects. Racial, sexual, religious or any forms of discriminations are not allwed in this course. 這門課的學生應該在各方面展示高水平的誠信和正直。課程中不允許任何形式的種族、性別、宗教或其他形式的歧視。
